segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Dana at Northstar Supply. I need to add four seats to our account for the operations team, ideally today if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, absolutely. I can help with that. Can you confirm the account name and the admin email on the workspace?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, account is Northstar Supply Group, and the admin email is dana.keller@northstarsupply.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks. I’ve got the account up in the admin console. You’re currently on the Business plan with 38 active seats, billed annually through April 30, 2026. You want to move that to 42 seats, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right, 42 total. The new users are all under our northstarsupply.com domain.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. I’m updating the seat count now. The prorated charge for the four seats through April 30 is $1,184.00 before tax, and it will appear on invoice 78241. Does that look okay to approve?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that’s fine. Same billing card and billing contact.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great, it’s processed. The four seats are available now, and I also refreshed the user provisioning limit so you should be able to invite them right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I see the count changed in the admin page. Can you send the invoice copy to accounting@northstarsupply.com too?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, I just sent the receipt and invoice copy to that address and to your billing contact on file. You should see it within a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. That’s all I needed, thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll close this out under ticket 519274, and if anything doesn’t look right with the invites, just reply to the confirmation email.
